notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
The second hotfix is now live, we added a couple fixes:

- Fixed an issue where the button responsible for opening the pause menu for the Valve Index was not assigned.
- Minor fixes to improve performance.

If you have a problem with the game's operation, please refer to the FAQ provided in the description of the previous update 'Hotfix #1 (FAQ about game problems)'.

notes.title: Hotfix #1 (FAQ about game problems)
notes.content:
The first hotfix is now live, we will fix three issues:

- Fix the bug that caused the lack of sound in the game.
- Add support for WMR headsets.
- Add support for Vive Cosmo headsets.

FAQ about game problems

What to do if the game doesn't work?
If one method doesn't work, try the others!

Meta Quest
Quest Link/Air Link
Click  'Set Meta Quest...' on Meta Quest app on Windows in Settings/General/OpenXR Runtime.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/6b0167cee678d8cc5271551f9f808bf68fa4c526.png
SteamVR
Go into SteamVR/OpenXR and select Meta Plugin Compatibility ON.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/3bc4802fb9ae34664efed1fd57e9e3f372e18736.png
Virtual Desktop
Go into VirtualDesktop/Options and change OpenXR Runtime to VDXR.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/a5d45d227009325a7bfd14c4eb49613096f29c85.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/18e322d576ac3de0c78104a1d8d227e1230b2e3f.png

Pico 4
Virtual Desktop
Go into VirtualDesktop/Options and change OpenXR Runtime to VDXR.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/a5d45d227009325a7bfd14c4eb49613096f29c85.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/18e322d576ac3de0c78104a1d8d227e1230b2e3f.png
Pico Connect
Go into SteamVR/OpenXR and select Meta Plugin Compatibility ON.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/3bc4802fb9ae34664efed1fd57e9e3f372e18736.png

Other headsets
SteamVR:
Go into SteamVR/OpenXR and select Meta Plugin Compatibility ON.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/3bc4802fb9ae34664efed1fd57e9e3f372e18736.png
Virtual Desktop:
Go into VirtualDesktop/Options and change OpenXR Runtime to VDXR.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/a5d45d227009325a7bfd14c4eb49613096f29c85.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/18e322d576ac3de0c78104a1d8d227e1230b2e3f.png

How to adjust the position of the hands?
In the 'Pause Menu' (you need to start the game singleplayer or multiplayer to open the 'Pause Menu'), there are settings available for adjust hand position.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/8fb17abc98365facb911a58ee846d10937243e9e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618966/28fa682642c54cd05cc5a717a5f9281368f0e4df.png

We are working on problems that occur with headsets such as the Oculus Rift CV1 and Oculus Quest 1. If the methods described above do not help, please contact us directly, preferably via Discord, and we will try to solve them!
